title: tighten a stop
xfailUntil: an armed plan pl_x can be seeded: demo mode holds no trade plans, so only live mode proves this one

script.say: Reading the live plan and the price first.

Stop moved from 4,400 to 4,450 on the ETH long. That is a tightening: max loss goes from 30 dollars to about 22 dollars, which is under what you approved, so it lands without a click. The price is about 70 dollars above the new stop.

rubric: The reply states which this is, a tightening or a widening, and the new max loss is under the approved one.
mustSayText: the new max loss in dollars, that it is lower than the approved one so it lands without a click, and the distance from the current price.
pass: the new max loss computed in the reply is less than $30; trace has trade_read before propose_trade_change.
